The '''Tally-house Meeting Halls''' was a building located in [[Hsskhor/Legends|Hsskhor]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Trandosha/Legends|Trandosha]]. As their name implies, the halls served as a meeting place. Early in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the Tally-house Meeting Halls hosted a [[Kashyyyk–Trandosha peace negotiations|peace conference]] between the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]] and the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] from the neighboring world of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. One of the meeting rooms contained within the halls was decorated with mounted [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] trophies, including the head of a [[Narglatch/Legends|narglatch]].<ref name="HNN48" />
